reply.emotion: warm and affectionate, speaking of someone dear and belonging to you
notes: Use 'hijo' to specifically refer to a male child. To refer to a child of either gender, use the plural 'hijos'. If you want to talk about children in general (of any age or gender), use 'hijos' or 'niños' depending on whether you mean offspring or just young people.

senses.definition: A male person in relation to his parents.
A child of either gender in relation to their parents.
